about: What the repo says is built and should be live, with one read-only check each. scripts/repo-vs-live.js reads this file. When you build something that waits on a deploy, a database paste or a switch, add a row here in the same PR; when it is live, leave the row (it then prints LIVE) until the next tidy-up. Probes must be one SELECT that returns one yes/no or one count, never a name. Ledger numbers are docs/ops/OPEN_REPAIRS.md entries.

probes.sql: select coalesce((select position('client_create_email_required' in prosrc) = 0 from pg_proc where proname='client_create_native' limit 1), false)

probes.what: client_create_native: no EXECUTE for anon or authenticated
probes.sql: select count(*) from pg_proc p where p.proname='client_create_native' and (has_function_privilege('anon', p.oid, 'EXECUTE') or has_function_privilege('authenticated', p.oid, 'EXECUTE'))
